clauses.reason: The lead clause recites the authority and the purpose of facilitating the work of the Commission on United States-Pacific Trade and Investment Policy and directs that Executive Order 12964 of June 21, 1995 be amended as set out in items (i) and (ii). Executive Order 13062 of September 29, 1997 provides in its section 3 that "(b) Executive Order 12964, as amended by Executive Orders 12987 and" is revoked, in the list of Executive orders which established committees that have terminated and whose work is completed. That is an express revocation that names this order as an amendment of EO 12964. Its section 7 states "Sec. 7. This order shall be effective September 30, 1997." so the first-end date is 1997-09-30; the exclusive reading (the order ends when that day begins) is not needed because the effective date is stated, not an until-date.

Item (i) amends section 1(a) of EO 12964 to allow up to 20 members instead of 15 and item (ii) amends section 2(a) to put an about-December 31, 1996 date where the text had a before-February-1, 1996 date. Executive Order 13032 (signed 1996-12-26) replaces the December 31, 1996 date in section 2 with February 28, 1997; this is a strike-and-insert later event on item (ii) that changes its date, and the clause continues, amended. Executive Order 13062 of September 29, 1997 provides in its section 3 that "(b) Executive Order 12964, as amended by Executive Orders 12987 and" is revoked, in the list of Executive orders which established committees that have terminated and whose work is completed. That is an express revocation that names this order as an amendment of EO 12964. Its section 7 states "Sec. 7. This order shall be effective September 30, 1997." so the first-end date is 1997-09-30; the exclusive reading (the order ends when that day begins) is not needed because the effective date is stated, not an until-date.

research_rationale:
EO 12987 (signed 1996-01-31; 61 FR 4205) was read in full in the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12987.txt. It amends Executive Order 12964 (Commission on United States-Pacific Trade and Investment Policy): (i) section 1(a) membership from 15 to up to 20 and (ii) the report date in section 2(a). The dossier evidence ACT:EO:12987>EO:13062 was re-read against the held EO 13062 text: section 3(b) revokes EO 12964 as amended by EO 12987 and EO 13032, and section 7 gives the express effective date 1997-09-30. EO 13032 (1996-12-26) replaces the date in section 2 with 1997-02-28. EO 12964 section 4 terminates the Commission 30 days after its final report. Machine searches read: U.S. Code 0 hits, eCFR 0 hits, Federal Register catalog 3 hits. Under the owner rulings of 2026-10-21 (report deadline, strike-and-insert) and 2026-10-28 the end is the revocation that names EO 12987, the date amendment is a later event, and the report-relative termination is a spent fact not held.
